text: We hired Heather to paint the first dance at our wedding. She went above and beyond our (already high) expectations! Our guests absolutely loved watching and talking with Heather as the painting came to life. We continue to get compliments on her work nearly 5 months later! She not only provided another form of entertainment at our reception, but gave us a beautiful piece of fine artwork to proudly display in our home forever. Heather's professionalism and attention to detail are top notch. I cannot recommend working with her enough, if I were to do our wedding day all over again, I would hire Heather without question.

owner_reply.text: Thank you so much for having me join your wedding! I absolutely loved hearing your ideas for your painting and making it all come to life! Your painting will always be so special to me! It was such a gorgeous event!! Thank you for sharing your experience!
